nights.title: Vilma Palma e Vampiros
nights.name: Vilma Palma e Vampiros
nights.extract: Vilma Palma e Vampiros is an Argentine new wave indie rock en español band from Rosario. They came to prominence in 1992 after the release of the hits "Bye, Bye" and "La Pachanga".
